2. Accused petitioner along with other accused persons stand indicted for com-mission of crime punishable under Sections 302/34 of the Penal Code in Mirpur Police Station Case No. 100 dated 23/8/1999 registered on the strength of a First Information Report laid by Md. Nurul Amin, father of victim Abdul Jalil. 

 3. The case projected in the First Information Report is that accused petitioner and other accused persons in a planned way under the leadership of Barb Jahangir being armed with deadly weapons chased informant's son victim Abdul Jalil. Accused Moksud shot at the head of victim Jalil and accused Nata Jahangir dealt a chapati blow on the head of victim Abdul Jalil, Accused petitioner Kana Babul with knife in his hand dealt blow on jaw of victim. Accused Mohshin dealt a chapati blow on the left ear of victim. Other accused persons conjointly started beating victim. Victim Jalil succumbed to injuries. 

 Prayer for bail as unsuccessfully moved before Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka. Bail as thereafter moved before the Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Dhaka in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 1239 of 2000 but without any better result. Metropolitan Sessions Judge by order dated 21/11/2000 refused to enlarge the accused petitioner on bail. 

 Regard being had to the part played by accused petitioner in commission of crime and nature of injury manifested in post modern report and long delay in completion of investigation we are of this considered view that the accused petitioner made Out a case for his being released on bail. 

 6. This criminal Miscellaneous Case stands allowed. Rule is, accordingly made absolute. Accused petitioner Md. Mashiur Rahman alias Kana Babul, son of Abdus Salam Is released on bail on furnishing bail bond in the sum of Taka 50,000/-with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka.
